entry.passwordChange.heading: Choose a new password
entry.passwordChange.introduction: Password replacement is required before MIA can continue.
entry.passwordChange.password.label: New password (required)
entry.passwordChange.password.help: Use 12 to 128 characters and at most 512 bytes. Spaces, Unicode, and password-manager values are allowed. Your password is not trimmed or normalized. Very common passwords are not accepted.
entry.passwordChange.confirmation.label: Confirm new password (required)
entry.passwordChange.confirmation.help: Enter exactly the same password again.
entry.passwordChange.errorSummary: Correct these problems before saving your new password:
entry.passwordChange.tooShort: The new password is too short. Use at least 12 characters.
entry.passwordChange.tooLong: The new password is too long. Use at most 128 characters and 512 bytes.
entry.passwordChange.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password. Enter exactly the same password in both fields.
entry.passwordChange.rejected: That password was not accepted. Choose a different password that meets the rules above.
entry.passwordChange.throttled: Password replacement is temporarily limited. Wait before trying again.
entry.passwordChange.wait: Wait at least {seconds, number} seconds before trying again.

entry.recovery.introduction: Staff accounts: enter your username, and MIA emails a password-reset link to the verified address of an eligible account. Students: ask your supervisor to set a temporary password.

entry.recovery.accepted: If an eligible account exists, we've sent an email with a password-reset link. Any link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.
entry.recovery.csrfRejected: The security check for this page expired. Send the request again.
entry.recovery.unknown: We couldn't confirm your request. An email may still arrive, so check your email before sending again.
entry.authRequest.failed: Your request couldn't be processed. Try again later.

entry.reset.unknown.heading: Password change not confirmed

entry.reset.trySignIn: Try signing in with your new password
entry.reset.changed.heading: Your password has been changed.
entry.reset.changed.mfa: If you use multi-factor authentication, it remains enabled.
entry.reset.changed.otherBrowsers: Other browsers where you are signed in are not signed out automatically. Those sign-ins expire on their own.

entry.reset.signedOut: Signed out. You can now choose a new password.

entry.invitation.preview.introduction: You've been invited to create a MIA account. Accepting creates the account; you then sign in as usual.

entry.invitation.invalid.heading: This invitation link is invalid or no longer usable
entry.invitation.invalid: If you already have an account, sign in. Otherwise, ask the person who invited you for a new invitation.
entry.invitation.accept.introduction: Choose your username and password, and confirm your language, country, and time zone.
entry.invitation.username.help: 3 to 32 characters: letters A–Z, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens. Start and end with a letter or digit.

entry.invitation.throttled: Too many attempts. Enter your password again and submit once the wait has passed.

mfa.enroll.heading: Set up multi-factor authentication
mfa.verify.heading: Verify multi-factor authentication
mfa.codes.heading: MFA recovery codes
mfa.overview.introduction: Multi-factor authentication asks for a code from another device each time you sign in.
mfa.status.onTotp: You confirm each sign-in with a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.status.onSms: You confirm each sign-in with a code sent by text message.
mfa.status.onCodesNote: Recovery codes are shown only once, when multi-factor authentication is set up.
mfa.status.offHelp: Set up an authenticator app to add a second step when you sign in.
mfa.status.unavailable: Setup is not available for your account right now.
mfa.status.pendingSms: This pending text-message setup can only be cancelled here.
mfa.enroll.introduction: You need an authenticator app on another device, such as your phone.
mfa.enroll.stepStart: Start setup to get a QR code and a setup key.
mfa.enroll.stepScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key.
mfa.enroll.stepCode: Enter the six-digit code that your authenticator app shows.
mfa.verify.introduction: Add MIA to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
mfa.setup.qrLabel: QR code for adding MIA to your authenticator app
mfa.setup.manualHelp: If you cannot scan the QR code, enter these values in your authenticator app.
mfa.setup.hiddenHelp: The QR code and setup key were hidden while you were away. Show them again when no one else can see your screen.
mfa.setup.notShown: The QR code and setup key for this setup cannot be shown again. If you already added MIA to your authenticator app, enter its current code. Otherwise, cancel this setup and start again.
mfa.setup.uriRejected: MIA received setup data it cannot use, so no QR code or setup key is shown. Cancel this setup and start again.
mfa.verify.codeLabel: Six-digit code from your authenticator app (required)
mfa.verify.codeHelp: Enter the code that is currently shown. Leading zeros count.
mfa.verify.noPending: There is no pending setup to verify.
mfa.outcome.codeInvalid: That code was not accepted. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
mfa.outcome.setupGone: This setup has ended. It may have expired or received too many incorrect codes. Start a new setup.
mfa.outcome.codesLost: Multi-factor authentication is now on, but the recovery codes from this setup could not be shown. They cannot be retrieved. Only a future replacement of this factor issues new codes.
mfa.outcome.verifyUnknownPending: We could not confirm whether your code was accepted. The setup is still pending, so you can enter a new code.
mfa.outcome.verifyRejected: Your code could not be checked.
mfa.outcome.notSent: The request was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
mfa.outcome.throttled: There have been too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
mfa.outcome.startUnknownPending: We could not confirm the setup response. A setup is pending, but its QR code and setup key cannot be shown.
mfa.outcome.startUnknownNone: Setup did not start. You can start again.
mfa.outcome.pendingExists: A setup is already pending. Continue it or cancel it before starting again.
mfa.outcome.cancelRejected: The setup could not be cancelled.
mfa.outcome.cancelUnknownPending: We could not confirm whether the setup was cancelled. It is still pending, so you can cancel it again.
mfa.outcome.cancelUnknownGone: The setup is no longer pending.
mfa.outcome.checkFailed: We could not check your multi-factor authentication status.
mfa.codes.warning: Each code works once if you cannot use your authenticator app. MIA shows these codes only now and cannot show them again. MIA cannot remove copies from your clipboard, screenshots, print queue, or paper.
mfa.codes.copyFailure: Recovery codes could not be copied. Select and copy them manually.
mfa.codes.printInitiated: Print dialog requested. Printing is not confirmed.
mfa.codes.printFailure: Printing could not start. Copy the codes or write them down.
mfa.codes.acknowledge: I have saved my recovery codes
mfa.codes.acknowledgeHelp: Store them somewhere safe and private. You will not see them again.
mfa.codes.acknowledgeFirst: Confirm that you saved your recovery codes first.
mfa.codes.hiddenHelp: Your recovery codes were hidden while you were away. Show them again when no one else can see your screen.
mfa.codes.unavailable: Recovery codes are no longer available. They are shown only once and cannot be retrieved. Only a future replacement of this factor issues new codes.
